entries.scope: Remove machine-local inventory exports and an obsolete SQLite build database from the current tracked source snapshot
entries.rationale: DE: Die Bereinigung ändert die Security-Evidence und muss die Grenze zwischen aktuellem Git-Stand, unveränderter Historie und externer Credential-Disposition klar dokumentieren. EN: The cleanup changes security evidence and must clearly document the boundary between the current Git snapshot, unchanged history, and external credential disposition.
entries.navigationImpact: No navigation change; existing security reader paths remain authoritative.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in synchronized CEFR-B2 evidence text.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Darwin verification confirms that the five files remain locally available while the Git index and ignore rules exclude them; provider credential status is documented separately.
entries.risk: High if current-tree cleanup is misrepresented as history removal or complete credential revocation.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: History rewrite, credential disposition, provider-log evidence, inventory export policy, or secret-redaction behavior changes.
